title: Tailor's Lining Rate Card for Added Work — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
On a lined garment's Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, the lined-work basis for an operation added after drop-off takes exactly one of three forms, set by the operation charge the surcharge is priced on and by the lining work already on the ticket. The operation charge it is priced on is the most recently booked operation charge on the ticket, the higher one where several share that latest booking date.

| That operation charge | Lined surcharge charges already standing on the ticket | Lined-work basis |
|---|---|---|
| under 40.00 USD | any number | a flat lining charge of 5.00 USD |
| 40.00 USD or more | two or more | 2.00 USD for each lined operation the lining is reworked around: 2.00 USD multiplied by one more than the lined surcharge charges already standing |
| 40.00 USD or more | fewer than two | the class's lined-garment surcharge percentage of the whole charge |

## Thresholds, both sides

- **Operation charge, threshold 40.00 USD.** 39.99 USD: flat 5.00 USD. 40.00 USD: one of the two lower rows.
- **Lined surcharge charges standing, threshold 2.** One standing: the percentage row. Two standing: the reworked-lining row.

## Hypothetical cases

| Operation charge priced on | Lined surcharge charges standing | Lined-work basis |
|---|---|---|
| 28.00 USD | 0 | 5.00 USD |
| 28.00 USD | 3 | 5.00 USD |
| 145.00 USD | 2 | 2.00 multiplied by 3, that is 6.00 USD |
| 145.00 USD | 3 | 2.00 multiplied by 4, that is 8.00 USD |
| 85.00 USD | 1 | the class percentage of 85.00 USD; at, say, 25 percent, 21.25 USD |
